Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_0_DESCRIPTION
Text: Crazed military bot running rampant right next to Pirate Bay.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_1_DESCRIPTION
Text: Runs his own drug farm in a harbor area basement. Really likes his bacon.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_2_DESCRIPTION
Text: Automated killing machine that dominates the Pearl Beach. It's not alone.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_3_DESCRIPTION
Text: Its mandibles can cut your gun in half and snap your head right off.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_4_DESCRIPTION
Text: Don't rile him up. Just don't.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_5_DESCRIPTION
Text: The very model of a modern pirate. With a big, nasty hammer.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_6_DESCRIPTION
Text: Designed to run down buildings. Guess what it can do to you.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_8_DESCRIPTION
Text: Runs the slave girl trade on Dawnbreak. Completely ruthless and ready to protect her depraved business.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_9_DESCRIPTION
Text: Hanging around these laboratories can do this to you.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_10_DESCRIPTION
Text: The experiments have producer many terrible results. This is probably the worst.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_11_DESCRIPTION
Text: Never leaves the caverns, so there is only one way of settling the score. Enter the inferno.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_12_DESCRIPTION
Text: Does not bother to stalk. It does not have to.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_13_DESCRIPTION
Text: The leader of Mad Dogs is undoubtedly the craziest of them all. He needs to be put down.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_14_DESCRIPTION
Text: Gleaming gold Spiderbor covered with armored solar planels. Once at loose, the Sun Spidet just keeps going-- and going-- and going.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_15_DESCRIPTION
Text: Self-powered, fully automated, absolutely lethal. The perfect guard.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_16_DESCRIPTION
Text: Wears the power of voodoo. Don't wait until you see the whites of his eyes. Shoot when you still can.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_17_DESCRIPTION
Text: The rumor has it that the Mite hunts it victims to maintain its deadly, red gleam.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_18_DESCRIPTION
Text: Don't let the shine fool you. DAEMON's armor plates are of finest synthetic alloys, near impossible to crack.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_19_DESCRIPTION
Text: He loves his machines. Much more than you.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_20_DESCRIPTION
Text: As twisted as he is brilliant.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_21_DESCRIPTION
Text: Oh, yes. She'd very much like to play doctor with you. Just lay down and close your eyes...

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_22_DESCRIPTION
Text: Has worked for Labycore for years. Knows every sadistic trick not in the book.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_23_DESCRIPTION
Text: A particularly nasty part of Labycore's slave girl trade. The limits of his corruption are yet to be found.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_24_DESCRIPTION
Text: There are slave traders, and then there is The Diseased. Just don't let him touch you.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_25_DESCRIPTION
Text: Some people love their guns. Some people love them bit too much. To Mr. Arms they are a religion.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_26_DESCRIPTION
Text: The founder and owner of Queen of Diamonds. She knows all there is to know about vices and how to make money out of them.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_28_DESCRIPTION
Text: When you want the very best, you get yourself the VIP treatment. Just don't get on the wrong side of it.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_29_DESCRIPTION
Text: The finest piece of crowd control equipment. If you don't care about the crowd making it out alive.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_30_DESCRIPTION
Text: He loves his job and hates the scum that takes to the streets.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_31_DESCRIPTION
Text: Supersoldiers are the finest creation of Labycore laboratories. Only the finest of them become officers. Too bad the side effects include some mental unstability.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_34_DESCRIPTION
Text: Evolved to swim in lava and breathe flames. The looking glass won't be enough for this one.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_35_DESCRIPTION
Text: Often the slaves are the most valuable loot the raiders find. They are Slavemaster's business.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_36_DESCRIPTION
Text: Howls to the moon, speaks to the dead, and curses you to hell. Does it work? Who knows? But you better be prepared.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_37_DESCRIPTION
Text: Outside Dawnbreak there is no law, but the law of the strongest. And he is the strongest.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_38_DESCRIPTION
Text: This is the mother of all man-eating lizards. Literally! The Queen of Reptiles has an insatiable appetite.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_27_DESCRIPTION
Text: It's hard to be green. What Rockhead lacks in smarts, it makes up in hurts.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_32_DESCRIPTION
Text: This is Dawnbreak. But it does not make SPARTAN any less formidable.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_33_DESCRIPTION
Text: The most dangerous mutation that crawled out of the laboratories, born with a lethal affinity to fire.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_39_DESCRIPTION
Text: Don Wang united the dangerous Sicilian Mob and Asian Gang to create the Mad Dogs. His favorite method of liquidating enemies is by sitting on them.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_40_DESCRIPTION
Text: Driven by neverending hunger, man mutated with pig. Don't go near it or you will get bitten.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_41_DESCRIPTION
Text: Has uncontrolled feelings of hatred and anger towards you.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_43_DESCRIPTION
Text: Is green and full of poison. Run while you can.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_44_DESCRIPTION
Text: This half gorilla and half red tree is freak of nature. It likes to be alone.

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_45_DESCRIPTION
Text: Dr. Emmetts evil twin brother that makes you hope you crafted that shield...

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_48_DESCRIPTION
Text: Mutant Zombie that shoots rockets!! Run!

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_50_DESCRIPTION
Text: Whip it up...beware the zombie indiana jones like creature!

Name: TID_TIMELINE_EVENT_52_DESCRIPTION
Text: You can run but you can't hide from this Mutated Zombie Boss so better to slice him!
